🎥🎬: The King of Queens (1998)

Doug Heffernan is an easygoing delivery driver living in Queens, New York, with his sharp-witted wife, Carrie. Their seemingly ordinary marriage becomes a constant source of comedy as Doug’s love for food, television, and avoiding responsibility clashes with Carrie’s quick temper and ambitious personality.

Things get even more complicated when Carrie’s eccentric father, Arthur Spooner, moves into their home. His unpredictable behaviour, bizarre opinions, and endless demands turn everyday family life into a battlefield, while Doug’s best friend Deacon and their circle of friends add even more chaos to the mix.

From ridiculous arguments and failed schemes to awkward family moments, Doug and Carrie prove that marriage is never boring when two stubborn personalities are involved. The King of Queens is a hilarious look at working-class life, friendship, and the everyday madness of married life.

source_details.synopsis: The King of Queens is an American television sitcom that ran on CBS from September 21, 1998, to May 14, 2007, with a total of 207 half-hour episodes spanning nine seasons. The series was created by Michael J. Weithorn and David Litt, who also served as executive producers, and stars Kevin James and Leah Remini as Doug and Carrie Heffernan, a working-class couple living in Rego Park. All episodes were filmed in front of a live studio audience. The King of Queens was produced by Hanley Productions and CBS Productions (1998–2007)/CBS Paramount Television (2007), in association with Columbia TriStar Television (1998–2002), and Sony Pictures Television (2002–07).
